cues.description: An elevator car stops at a floor and opens its doors.
Loops while an elevator car in view is moving between floors.
The player places a floor, unit, stairs or elevator shaft.
The player demolishes something with the bulldozer tool.
Rent, a lease payment or a sale is collected.
A notice appears on the news line, except the bomb and fire alerts.
Loops from the bomb decision opening until it closes or the threat ends.
Loops from the fire start until its decision closes or the fire ends.
Once per wedding, when the procession reaches the cathedral.
Morning check of the hotel: guests wake up and newspapers are delivered.
Loops while a lobby floor is visible on screen.
The player presses a toolbar button or a window button.
